_mode_doc: Fresh-generate mode: every weekly run calls Canva:generate-design from scratch with brand kit applied. No master templates required yet. Switch to registered-master mode once a polished template is confirmed.

theme_signature._doc: TitoAI visual theme: dark navy background + gold accents + Bebas Neue bold headlines. Human, warm, editorial — not techy. Matches manifesto color system.
theme_signature.headline_font: Bebas Neue bold, white, large — takes upper portion of frame
theme_signature.hero_media_treatment: Framed video thumbnail / still in center of frame — not full-bleed, gives breathing room for headline above and logo below
theme_signature.logo_lockup: TITO AI wordmark or logo-icon.png at bottom of frame
theme_signature.feel: Warm, human, approachable — like a Tito giving advice, not a tech brand selling something

canva_workspace._brand_kit_note: Set this once the Tito AI brand kit is created in Canva. Source assets: files2/logo-horizontal.png, files2/logo-icon.png

media_source._note: Primary media source is local. Videos/Intro has the launch video assets (MP4 + JPG stills). Add new subfolders per content type.

01-mon-ai-tip.name: TAI-Tip-Reel-Master
01-mon-ai-tip.script_format: Talking head, 30-60 seconds, no B-roll needed
01-mon-ai-tip.hook_template: Alam mo ba na pwede mong [result] in less than [time]?
01-mon-ai-tip.generation_prompt: Vertical TikTok/Reels cover graphic (9:16, 1080x1920) for Tito AI — a Filipino AI education channel. Monday AI Tip post. LAYOUT: Dark navy background (#0A0F1E) dominant. Large bold Bebas Neue headline in white, top portion of frame, multi-line (placeholder 'AI TIP NI TITO'). Hero still image or phone screen capture in a framed window, center of frame, NOT full-bleed. Gold (#F59E0B) accent line or geometric element as brand signature. Small 'TITO AI' wordmark at bottom, white. FEEL: warm, approachable, Tito-giving-advice energy — never corporate, never hard-sell. Filipino audience — the visual should feel like a kuya sharing something useful.

02-wed-demo.name: TAI-Demo-Reel-Master
02-wed-demo.script_format: Split screen: face cam + screen share, 60-90 seconds
02-wed-demo.hook_template: Pakinggan mo ito. [Pain point na relatable].
02-wed-demo.generation_prompt: Vertical TikTok/Reels cover graphic (9:16, 1080x1920) for Tito AI — Filipino AI education. Wednesday Demo/Tutorial post. LAYOUT: Dark navy background (#0A0F1E). Bold Bebas Neue headline in white, top frame (placeholder 'DEMO: [TOOL NAME]'). Screenshot of AI tool or phone screen in a framed window, center of frame. Teal (#0D9488) accent element — subtle highlight box or line. Gold 'LIBRE ✓' badge in upper corner to reinforce free tools. 'TITO AI' logo lockup at bottom. FEEL: demonstrates capability, shows real results — trustworthy, not hype-y. Filipino everyday context.

03-fri-inspiration.name: TAI-Story-Reel-Master
03-fri-inspiration.script_format: Talking head, 60-90 seconds, story format: hook → struggle → win → apply
03-fri-inspiration.hook_template: [Number] years old ako at [surprising thing I can now do].
03-fri-inspiration.generation_prompt: Vertical TikTok/Reels cover graphic (9:16, 1080x1920) for Tito AI — Filipino AI education. Friday Story/Inspiration post. LAYOUT: Dark navy background (#0A0F1E). Large serif (Lora) or Bebas Neue headline in white, top-left, multi-line — emotionally resonant (placeholder 'DINALA AKO NG AI DITO'). Hero photo of Joseph in a framed window, center — warm, natural light, at-home or Silicon Valley setting. Gold (#F59E0B) accent elements in opposing corners — warm, not sharp. 'TITO AI' wordmark bottom center. FEEL: warm human story, not a tech flex. Filipino relatability — household dad, OFW, ordinary person who made it work.
